feature: # mean_abs_shap: canonical SHAP importance - average absolute SHAP value across sampled test rows. Higher = more influential overall
# mean_signed_shap: average directional SHAP contribution. Positive = on average pushes toward Win=+1; negative = toward Loss=-1; near zero = directionally balanced
# mean_abs_shap_pos_class: mean |SHAP| over sampled rows where TRUE label = +1 (wins). How much the feature is engaged when predicting actual wins
# mean_abs_shap_neg_class: mean |SHAP| over sampled rows where TRUE label = -1 (losses). How much the feature is engaged when predicting actual losses
# class_asymmetry_pos_minus_neg: pos_class - neg_class. Positive = feature mostly contributes to win predictions; negative = mostly to loss predictions; near zero = balanced contributor
